title: Fan mimic with pack symbols
description: Platform demo matrix: Fan mimic with pack symbols
prompt: Create mimic demo-fan under mimics. First load the platform symbol catalog, then save a diagram that contains ONLY catalog symbols whose ids start with pack. or pump. — specifically include pack.ispf-pid.fan and pump.centrifugal. Bind each element's running property to demo-device-1.deviceActive. Do not add any label, button, text, or custom.svg elements at all. Create the virtual device if needed.
